svg.text: Every other key screen, as sheets on the light table · same shell, same zone ramp, magenta only for moves

g.text: Plans are shared by everyone and reopen exactly as they were left.
“12,5” is not a whole number. Fix the file and upload it again.

Settings: period 12 months · 24 / 6 / 1 picks · pick group 5 shared jobs
Row menu: Manual move · Keep in place · Show on map
Same rows as the map: B = best location, dotted = keep in place
214 pick groups · two parts with 5 or more shared jobs
Magenta corner: different aisles, rule 3 may suggest a move
Click an aisle, a level, or a single location to mark it
Best comes only from marks, never from Walk Path.

Updates after every move, undo and reset.
Round order · a location is emptied before a part moves in · page 1 of 1
